$comment: Run O1 lane K1 batch b10: series data for One Piece (tier A), built from pinned Wikipedia revisions (manga article, 1999 TV series article, episode list, character list, Japanese article for the native title) and Wikidata Q28667972 (manga); facts are drafts for review. This file replaces the frozen contract fixture of the same slug; the fixture quizzes (fx-) are not part of the data folder. Arcs are the story arcs of the Wikipedia arc table that appear in both media or only in the Toei anime, in anime order: 46 arcs, with the manga chapters and anime episodes of the table (an episode range runs from the first to the last episode of the arc and swallows tie-in specials inside it: Little East Blue sits inside Impel Down, the Toriko crossovers inside Marineford, Fish-Man Island, Punk Hazard, and Cidre Guild and Uta's Past inside Land of Wano). anime_only marks the 14 fillers of the table (Warship Island, Dreams!, Goat Island, Ruluka Island, G-8, Ocean's Dream, Foxy's Return, Ice Hunter, Chopper Man, Spa Island, Z's Ambition, Caesar Retrieval, Silver Mine, Marine Rookie), which have no chapters. The manga is ahead of the anime: Elbaph is the current arc of both, the manga from chapter 1126 and the anime from episode 1156 (April 5, 2026), and the anime had reached episode 1180 by September 27, 2026; no arc is flagged manga only because every manga arc up to Elbaph has aired. Not arcs here: the cover stories (manga only), the OVA, the festival film chapters and the one-shot Romance Dawn specials. The status is airing because the anime still airs; the volume count (115) is that of July 3, 2026, and Wikidata still shows 111 volumes and 1169 episodes, so it was not cited for those numbers. No chapter total is given because the sources only say 'over 1175'. No director is given because the 1999 series has had many. Themes are the 29 openings and 23 endings of the TV series table (the special opening New Genesis for episodes 1028 to 1030 is not numbered and is left out); in the English article the intro still says 27 and 21. Japanese names of the characters are the ja labels of their Wikidata items (Q477948 Luffy, Q858432 Zoro, Q877964 Nami, Q1078696 Usopp, Q1061765 Sanji, Q1152213 Chopper, Q1190653 Robin, Q1190670 Franky, Q4376780 Brook, Q2486996 Vivi, Q2321523 Shanks, Q2605496 Buggy, Q2084755 Ace, Q9072468 Sabo, Q2640110 Mihawk, Q2720493 Whitebeard, Q2726975 Crocodile, Q3997231 Law, Q5148704 Kid, Q1404614 Doflamingo, Q25399069 Linlin, Q22933371 Kaido, Q858559 Sakazuki, Q2359852 Hancock, Q2619344 Roger, Q2727057 Smoker, Q3725237 Eneru, Q3938161 Lucci, Q3321006 Dragon), Yamato from the English character list. Character debut arcs and spoiler levels are editorial judgments (a crew member is safe only once they have joined); when unsure the later arc was chosen.

characters.name: Monkey D. Luffy
characters.description: A young pirate with a rubber body who sails to find the One Piece and become King of the Pirates.

characters.name: Roronoa Zoro
characters.description: A swordsman who fights with three swords and dreams of becoming the world's greatest.

characters.name: Shanks
characters.description: A pirate captain who inspired Luffy as a boy and trusted him with his treasured straw hat.

characters.name: Gol D. Roger
characters.description: The late King of the Pirates, whose last words at his execution set off a new age of piracy.

characters.name: Nami
characters.description: A talented navigator and thief who dreams of drawing a map of the entire world.

characters.name: Buggy
characters.description: A clown-faced pirate captain who ate the Chop-Chop Fruit, which lets his body split apart.

characters.name: Usopp
characters.description: A sharpshooter and gifted liar from Syrup Village who dreams of becoming a brave warrior of the sea.

characters.name: Sanji
characters.description: A cook from the Baratie restaurant who fights with powerful kicks and dreams of finding the All Blue.

characters.name: Dracule Mihawk
characters.name_native: ジュラキュール・ミホーク
characters.description: A swordsman called Hawk-Eyes, widely regarded as the strongest in the world.

characters.name: Smoker
characters.description: A Marine captain who chases Luffy from Loguetown and can turn his body into smoke.

characters.name: Monkey D. Dragon
characters.name_native: モンキー・D・ドラゴン
characters.description: The most wanted man in the world, who leads the Revolutionary Army against the World Government.

characters.name: Nefertari Vivi
characters.description: The princess of Alabasta, who travels with the Straw Hats to stop a rebellion tearing her kingdom apart.

characters.name: Tony Tony Chopper
characters.name_native: トニートニー・チョッパー
characters.description: A reindeer who ate the Human-Human Fruit and serves as the Straw Hats' doctor.

characters.name: Crocodile
characters.description: A Warlord of the Sea and secret boss of Baroque Works, who plots to seize the kingdom of Alabasta.

characters.name: Portgas D. Ace
characters.name_native: ポートガス・D・エース
characters.description: Luffy's older sworn brother, a pirate who wields the power of fire.

characters.name: Nico Robin
characters.description: An archaeologist who can sprout extra limbs anywhere and who seeks the true history of the world.

characters.name: Eneru
characters.description: The self-proclaimed god of Skypiea, who rules the sky island with the power of lightning.

characters.name: Franky
characters.description: A cyborg shipwright from Water 7 who builds and repairs ships.

characters.name: Rob Lucci
characters.description: A top agent of the government's CP9 who can transform into a leopard.

characters.name: Brook
characters.description: A living skeleton musician who plays the violin and sails with the Straw Hats.

characters.name: Trafalgar Law
characters.name_native: トラファルガー・ロー
characters.description: The captain of the Heart Pirates, a surgeon known as the Surgeon of Death.

characters.name: Eustass Kid
characters.description: The captain of the Kid Pirates, a rookie pirate who commands magnetic power.

characters.name: Boa Hancock
characters.description: The Pirate Empress who rules Amazon Lily and is a Warlord of the Sea.

characters.name: Edward Newgate
characters.description: The captain of the Whitebeard Pirates, widely called the strongest man in the world.

characters.name: Sakazuki
characters.description: A Marine admiral who wields magma and believes in absolute justice.

characters.name: Donquixote Doflamingo
characters.name_native: ドンキホーテ・ドフラミンゴ
characters.description: A flamboyant pirate and Warlord of the Sea who commands strings with the Thread-Thread Fruit.

characters.name: Sabo
characters.description: The Revolutionary Army's chief of staff, bound by oath as a brother to both Luffy and Ace.

characters.name: Charlotte Linlin
characters.name_native: シャーロット・リンリン
characters.description: An Emperor of the Sea who rules Whole Cake Island and has a hunger for sweets.

characters.name: Kaido
characters.description: An Emperor of the Sea called the strongest creature, who holds the Land of Wano under his rule.

characters.name: Yamato
characters.description: Kaido's daughter, who idolizes Kozuki Oden.

characters.name: Makino
characters.description: A bartender in Luffy's home village who had a big part in raising him.

characters.name: Koby
characters.description: A young hand pressed into chores aboard a pirate ship, and Luffy's first friend at sea.
